# STEP 2 — `Space_Invaders/plan.md` written

The full plan is on disk at `Space_Invaders/plan.md`. Its spine:

**1. Core Gameplay — the math.**
- **Player:** x = `clamp(x + v·dt, 1.2, 14.8)` at y = −4.2; fire rate 3.25/s; one live bullet (classic rule) + a 0.12 s cooldown.
- **Invader formation:** 11 × 5 grid, cell 1.05, anchored at (0, 2.6). March = `x += dir·speed·dt` with a hard turn at ±7.2 (no corner clipping). Descent 0.55 on every turn.
- **Speed law (the heart of the game):** `speed = 0.45 + 1.35·(1 − n/55)²` — 0.45 u/s at 55 alive, 1.80 u/s at 1 alive. Step frequency `f = 0.9 + 7.6·(1 − n/55)` Hz (0.9 → 8.5 Hz), quantized to 8 steps for the classic staccato.
- **Invader descent:** `y = 2.6 − 0.55·(5 − row) − 0.55·turns` → bottom row reaches the player line at turn 14 — a real, reachable loss condition.
- **Scoring:** 10/20/30 by row; UFO 50–300; 1-up at 1000 (max 5); 3 lives; 10 waves, win on the 10th.
- **Collisions:** swept-AABB for bullets (substep at max 0.35 u per substep — no tunneling at 14 u/s), AABB for the invader sweep, circle-vs-AABB for the UFO.

**2. Modern Enhancements (18).** InstancedMesh invader fleet (55 instances, 1 draw call) with per-instance color + emissive; per-instance death animation (scale→0, spin, flash) before pool release; instanced bullets; procedural 3-frame sprite animation via a `uFrame` uniform; 3D parallax starfield (1200 points, 3 depth layers, wrap-around); neon grid floor with distance-fade shader injection; scanline + vignette + chromatic-aberration post stack; trauma shake + hit-stop + 500-cap particles + motion trails + shockwave rings + floating score text (all six VFX); WebAudio synthesized SFX + generative 4-bar sequencer that accelerates with the step rate; glassmorphism HUD with a score ticker; 1-up jingle; wave-transition banner; pause; full teardown.

**3. Graphics Pipeline.** `EffectComposer` → `RenderPass` → `UnrealBloomPass(strength 1.15, radius 0.55, threshold 0.72)` → `ShaderPass` (scanlines 0.12, vignette 0.35, chroma 0.0015) → `OutputPass`. Emissive discipline: emitters at 2.0–3.0 intensity, diffuse albedo dark, so bloom reads as glow, not whiteout.

**4. VFX priority.** Hit-stop (timescale 0.05–0.25 for 60–120 ms) → trauma shake (`trauma += min(1, impact/10)`, exponential decay, Simplex offset) → particles (budgeted: 26–40 per death, 120 for the player) → shockwave ring → floating text. All pooled, all in `shared/`.

**5. File Architecture (19 files).**
`shared/`: `utils/Math.js`, `utils/Noise.js`, `core/Engine.js`, `core/Input.js`, `core/ObjectPool.js`, `core/ParticleManager.js`, `core/CameraShake.js`, `core/HitStop.js`, `core/Shockwave.js`, `core/MotionTrail.js`, `core/FloatingText.js`, `core/Audio.js`, `core/ProceduralTextures.js`, `post/PostFX.js` — plus `Space_Invaders/`: `index.html`, `main.js`, `Game.js`, `Player.js`, `Invader.js`, `InvaderFleet.js`, `Bullet.js`, `Ufo.js`, `Arena.js`, `UI.js`. Import graph is strictly `game → shared → three`; every import resolves to a real export (verified by reading each file after writing).

**Edge cases covered:** last-invader bullet (no accidental win), bullet-vs-UFO priority, invader-bullet sweep substepping, formation turn at the exact boundary, DPR resize, tab-blur auto-pause, gamepad polling with edge-triggered actions, full `.dispose()` teardown.
